title: The seawall, no Discman
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday. The cover is the seawall at evening with no one on it and no Discman. The owner says he drew it with the Discman in June. Wood says the Discman's packed. She says he said the strip draws what's there. He says it's drawing what isn't. She says that's new. It is.

panels.composition: The cover: the seawall at evening, empty. No one. No Discman. The bay.

image.prompt: close on a photocopied booklet cover showing an empty seawall at evening above a gray bay, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The laundromat. The LAUNDRY owner. WOOD. BARNABY.

balloons.text: June, there was a Discman on it.
You said the strip draws what's there.

image.prompt: a laundromat owner holding a small booklet and speaking to a young man, black and white, no words
a laundromat owner, considering, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The digest in the rack. The empty wall facing the room. It is new. Monday the arc begins and the strip will draw what isn't there for a month.

image.prompt: a small booklet in a wire rack with an empty seawall on its cover, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'It's drawing what isn't.' 'That's new.' Monday: Arc 1.
